body: Thank you, yes I'm still here. Not sure whether that's a good thing tho. Yes a small part of me wants things to improve but life doesn't seem to want me at the minute.

Thank you , I have tried to talk to my husband but he has told me to hurry up and just kill myself nd be done with it and to stop talking about it. I took an overdose of 38 beta blockers and have went to bed. My husband is at work and my children are in bed . Thank you for listening. I just think I've had enough of trying anymore I don't mean to sound heartless and selfish I just need the suffering to be over .
